name: 道の駅 むなかた
desc: 福岡県宗像市にある道の駅「むなかた」は、九州屈指の売上と人気を誇る活気あふれるスポットです。最大の特徴は、目の前の玄界灘で水揚げされたばかりの新鮮な魚介類が豊富に揃うこと。開店前から行列ができるほどの人気ぶりです。特産品は、その新鮮な海鮮をはじめ、宗像牛や地元農家の朝採れ野菜、そして甘くて美味しいあまおう苺など。宗像の豊かな海と大地の恵みを存分に堪能できる、活気と魅力に満ちた道の駅です。
descEn: Located in Munakata City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Munakata" is a vibrant spot boasting some of the highest sales and popularity in Kyushu. Its greatest feature is the abundant selection of incredibly fresh seafood caught just off the coast in the Genkai Sea, drawing long lines of people even before it opens. Local specialties include this fresh seafood, Munakata beef, morning-harvested vegetables from local farmers, and sweet, delicious Amaou strawberries. It is a lively station where you can fully enjoy the rich blessings of Munakata's sea and land.
